summary_md: **ModelScope ([@ModelScope2022](https://x.com/ModelScope2022/status/2115383180291142043))** announces **MOSS-Image-EntroPack**, pre-quantized MOSS-Image packages (4.5-bit, 6-bit, entropy-coded INT8) that fit in 4 GB VRAM, with INT8 acceleration, separable DiT and text-encoder packages, and DiffSynth-Studio / ComfyUI support.
relevance: Brings an open image model down to very small local GPUs.

media.description: Grid of MOSS-Image samples of the same prompt (a woman in a pink dress on a Paris street with an 'EntroPack' neon sign) under the base model at bf16, 6-bit, int8@7, int8@6 and 4.5-bit quantization, showing near-identical outputs.
Same comparison grid for the SFT model: bf16 reference vs int8@7, int8@6, 6-bit, 4.5-bit and 3.5-bit, with the image staying close to the reference until the lowest bit width.
